text: Sherry (Japanese: , Sharī) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the Mimeosome Maintenance Center in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.
The Shadow Rise BC (Japanese: , Kageri no Oka BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, and is between New Los Angeles to the east and Starfall Basin to the west.

Shadow Adseculas (Japanese: , Shadou Apisu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Adsecula family, and can be found at level 11-13 or at level 17-20 at Silent Mire or Sickle Rock Rise in Primordia at night or in Headwater Cavern at any time. Six must be defeated for the Basic Mission Adsecula Extermination.
Shadow Scirpos (Japanese: , Shēdo Shirunea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Scirpo family, and can be found at level 18-20 in Oblivia's Devil's Colony.

Servant Sacrifice is one of many Debuff Arts in . If used on a target afflicted with Control, a fixed percentage of HP and TP based on the art level is earned, and there is a chance to instantly kill the target. The instant kill effect will always land if the target is under the effects of Topple or Stun. Tyrants and Bosses are immune to the Control debuff, and hence the effect of this art as well.

The Shivering Sands (Japanese: , Wananaki no Sunahara) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Sylvalum, northwest of the West Ciel Sandsea, and serves as the battlefield against Ga Jiarg and Ga Buidhe during Chapter 9. FN Site 401 is located here, as is the entrance to the Secluded Lava Lake.
Shallot is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at West Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles.
Shinshin (Japanese: , Shinshin) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at Ishmael Hills near the Cathedral in the Residential District of New Los Angeles during the night.
Serial Thriller (Japanese: , Kono Mira no Daichi de ne, Here in the Land of Mira) is an Affinity Mission in . It can be received near North Founders Street in the Commercial District.

Sentinel's Nest (Japanese: , Kenpei no Su) is an Unexplored Territory in . It is located in Noctilum. It consists of the terraces in the northeast corner of the Divine Roost. The Treasure Boxes here are guarded by hidden high-level Aeviters. As with all Unexplored Territories, its discovery yields an achievement ("Searching Sentinel's Nest"). Sentinel's Nest must be discovered to complete Off the Record (archaeological) in the Wii U version and Off the Record (biological) in the .

The Serpentine Pass (Japanese: , Sankan Hebimichi) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a path located in Noctilum, between the FN Site 205 and Cascade Isle. There are a large number of Mortifoles disguised as blue flowers here.
Shadow Flies (Japanese: , Kageshinkirou) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia.

Shiny Lamps (Japanese: , Pikapika Ranpu) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum. They can be obtained in the Vitriol Cesspool, northwest of FN Site 209 with a low chance. Gathering one is required during Professor B's Return.

Sekka Cosmoses (Japanese: , Sekka Kosumosu) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum around FN Site 222 or east from Jasper Incline. Gathering three of them is required during Forest Foray.

Shinuyuni Garlics (Japanese: , Shinuyu Nin'niku) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia, in particular near FN Site 315, FN Site 318, and FN Site 321. Ten bulbs are needed for Garlic 2.0.
Shido Persimmons (Japanese: , Shidogaki) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum, in particular in caves. Thirteen are required for Persimmons, Please!.
Sese Lilies (Japanese: , Seserakusa) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum.
Shia Cattleyas (Japanese: , Shia Katorea) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Seabird's Beak.
Shimmering Skins (Japanese: , Ruminasu Sukin) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found at Seabird's Beak. Eleven of these are needed for the basic mission Fell Fashion.

Shooting Fireflies (Japanese: , Shottohotaru) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, in particular on Slavebird Isle. Four are needed for the Basic Mission Party Procurement.
Sharpening Stones (Japanese: , Tonchinkankachi) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros.

Shaman Cervuses (Japanese: , Shāman Keruusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Cervus family, and can be found at level 45-46 at Delusians North Summit in Sylvalum. They disappear when the weather is spores.
Sheldon, the Dentally Challenged (, Shitsū no Sherudan) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Dilus family. It can be found at level 30 at West Ibra Ravine in Oblivia.

Sharnaak, the Technician (Japanese: , Tensai Gishi Sharunāku) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Milsaadi Ganglion member. He can be found at level 46 at Mount M'gando in Cauldros during nighttime, accompanied by two Rhenium Oc-servs. He may drop a unique Longsword named Ethereal Glaive: Helldragon.
Shrads (Japanese: , Zuttā) are a type of Ganglion's machines in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are small defensive ball-shaped drones that protect the Ganglion bases.

Sharnaak's Seidr (Japanese: , Sharunāku Sen'yō Basugia) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Seidr Ganglion machine. It can be found at level 84 at Ganglion Antropolis in Cauldros, hovering over a pool of water. It is the Seidr of Sharnaak, the Technician. It reflects Beam attacks.
Seeker Vigents (Japanese: , Shīkā Pekkā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Vigent family, and can be found at level 53-54 in Sylvalum near the Banshee Cave.

Seeker Blattas (Japanese: , Shīkā Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 41-50 in Cauldros, northeast segment surrounding Mount M'gando and north of the M'gando Gorge BC.

Shadow Germivores (Japanese: , Shēdo Burōsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Germivore family, and can be found at level 23-25 at Hilal Meadow and Needle Rock Sandsea in Sylvalum.

Seidr Control Devices are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Seidrs in Sylvalum and Cauldros. One can also be obtained from Alexa's Affinity Mission Rapid Misfire. Four of them are required to construct an Ares 70 Skell, and eight are need to construct an Ares 90. They are dropped by the same enemies which drop Upgraded Lenses, which are also needed to build the Ares Skells.

Sharp Germivore Jaws are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Germivores, or by trading 26 Reward Tickets at the Network Console. Three of them are needed for the Basic Mission Coolest of the Cool.

Shield Screen is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Shield Trooper at rank 4. The damage reduction occurs after Resistance calculation and rounds down the resulting number of damage taken. Cross, Lin, L, and H.B. can use this skill.

Sentinel Satellises (Japanese: , Senchineru Sateresu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion machines belonging to the Vita species. They are summoned at level 51-90 by Leva'el, the Terminus, which is a Tyrant found in Cauldros Waters only after Chapter 12. It is the only member of the Vita species to appear outside of the Vita boss battle, and the only other member besides the Vita itself to be registered in the Enemy Index.

Selenium Fal-swos (Japanese: , Seren Gi-suo) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Fal-swo machines, and can be found at level 31-40 on the path between M'gando Gorge BC and Kw'arah Cloister in Cauldros.

Senirapa Water is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is obtained during Circle of Life and given to Kon'luarb. There are multiple locations such as the mouth of Headwater Cavern north of FN Site 104 and the Bestial Utopia.
Shiny Mortifole Seeds are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Mortifoles.
Shimmering Silks are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Sacrifoles. Three units are needed for the related mission The Next Big Thing.

Shiraton (Japanese: , Shiraton) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are a Zaruboggan and can be found at West Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles. After Stop, Thief!, Shiraton will be near Barista Court.

Shrad Eyes are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from various Shrads in Sylvalum or Cauldros or for 54 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are one of the required components of Rank X - Rank XX Treasure Sensor augments. Three of them are needed for Skell Repair: Optics.
Sen'luarb is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is an Orphean who can be found at the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles at nighttime.

Shotgun Diplomacy (Japanese: , Jiyū Byōdō, Freedom, Equality) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Eliza in front of the Cathedral north doors, in the Residential District. The decision made when negotiating with Alex affects the ending of Alex's Last Stand.
Sevvy Belgazus (Japanese: , Sevi Berugazasu) is a NPC in . He can be found at the Starboard side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.

Settling the Score is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Like all Basic Missions, it can be received from the Mission Control Board on the BLADE Concourse in the Administrative District in New Los Angeles. It leads to the Normal Mission Alex's Last Stand.
Shrad Shredder is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Curators and the primary destination is Cauldros.
Selia Salbagath is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Prone, and can be found at the Starboard of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.

Shop Talk is Nagi's second Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It occurs in the morning, north of the large door in the Outfitters Test Hangar's main room, in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.

Shiny Copper Caro Plates are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from red-skinned Caro, or for 54 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in Thermal Res Up and SpecUp.THERM-RES augments.

Shiny Silver Caro Plates are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from blue-skinned Caro, or for 66 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in Damage.APPEND augments.
Shed Germivore Scales are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from purple Germivores in Sylvalum and Cauldros.
Shiny Black Caro Plates are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from white-skinned Caro.
Sharp Vivohast Jaws are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Vivohasts.
Seidr A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a standard black seidr variant wielding the hyper rail cannon weapon. It can be obtained from the Enhanced Attack Seidr in Cauldros.
Seidr B is a Holofigure in . It depicts a standard black seidr variant wielding the maximal missile weapon. It can be obtained from the Armored Cruiser Seidr in Cauldros.
Seidr C is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a standard black seidr variant wielding the fuse blower weapon. It can be obtained from the Enhanced Defense Seidr in Sylvalum.
Seidr D is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a golden seidr variant wielding the hyper rail cannon weapon. It can be obtained from Sharnaak's Seidr in Cauldros.
Seidr E is a Holofigure in . It depicts a red seidr variant wielding the maximal missile weapon. It can be obtained from Badul's Seidr in Sylvalum.
Seidr F is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a blue seidr variant wielding the fuse blower weapon. It can be obtained from Ahama's Seidr in Sylvalum.
Shrad A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a blue shrad variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from the Sector Security Shrad in Cauldros.

Shield Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Sakuraba Industries Shield. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Curios category of the Primordia Collectopedia. The Shield weapons available in-game are: * Combat Shield * Archetype Shield * Iron Shield * Carbide Shield * Cermet Shield * Chromoly Shield * Cobalt Shield * Titanium Shield * Ceramic Shield * Diamond Shield

Shiny and Floaty is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.2, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting ten Vespers. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Set Adrift is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.4, and is unlocked if a Petramand's acid sac is broken during Foul Feeding Petramands. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Shrad Test Lab is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.20, and is unlocked if a Gularth's abdomen was broken during Raging Lava Giants. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

The Shop Terminal is an accessible terminal in and . It can be found at the eastern end of Armory Alley in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. This console allows the player to purchase Armor, Weapons, Skell Weapons, and Skells.

Shock is a damaging debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Shock causes the afflicted to take electric-attribute damage every few seconds. The amount of damage dealt per instance is a portion of the initial attack's damage. Shock damage is shown as an orange-colored number.

The Shield Galdr (Japanese: , Shīrudo Garudora) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Ganglion Galdr and can be found at level 31 in Primordia's Bedrock Hold during route B of Blitzkrieg. It is part of an onslaught of enemies that must be defended against for five minutes.

|-|R630 Model= |-|XR640 Model= |-|XR660 Model= |-|XXR660 Model= Shotguns are sidearms for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from red Marnucks or Rail-Gun/M-Laser/B-Bomb/E-Bubble types Qmoevas.
Shorts are Casual Wear leg armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries.
The Ship Helm (Japanese: , Sōdashitsu) is a location in . It is located in the Ancient Ship, directly above the Entrance. There is a Treasure Trove here.
The Ship Bridge, Mid-Deck (Japanese: , Kankyō Chūō Kanpan) is a landmark in . It is located in the Ancient Ship, directly below the Entrance and above Hold #1. There is a Treasure Trove here.

Shroomblade Smithing (Japanese: , Kajiya Kinokosōdo) is a shop in . It is run by Denden and can be found at Argentum Bazaar in the Argentum Trade Guild's Goldmouth. Core Chips can be purchased and equipped to Blades here.

Seigle Fell (Japanese: , Seigaru Kyūryō) is a location in . It is located in the right area of the upper level of the Gormott Province, close to the back of the Titan's spine and Lyta Oasis. There is a hut with a Treasure Trove that can be accessed from a wooden bridge from here, as well as a Salvage Point.
The Shrine of Offering (Japanese: , Tōsotsu no Iseki) is a Location in . It is located in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
The Shrine of Light (Japanese: , Chishiki no Iseki) is a Location in . It is located in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
The Shrine of Journeys (Japanese: , Kyōjin no Iseki) is a Location in . It is located in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.

The Sevind Palace Plaza (Japanese: , Zēvinto Kyūden Hiroba) is a Location in . It is located in front of the Holy Gate of Fontana in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. The Urayan royal palace is located directly above the plaza. In , the ruins of the Sevind Palace Plaza appear as part of the Ruins of Seebu in the Urayan Tunnels. The three sets of stairs leading to the Sevind Palace Plaza have collapsed.
The Seoris Plaza West Gate (Japanese: , Seiririosu Hiroba Saimon) is a Landmark in . It is located in the Indoline Sanctum in the Indoline Praetorium.
Seoris Plaza (Japanese: , Seiririosu Hiroba) is a Location in . It is located in the Indoline Sanctum in the Indoline Praetorium.

Sekis Pillar (Japanese: , Serukesu Shichū) is a location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, between Hope's Horizon and the Lumos Pillar. The Heart-to-Heart "Tending to Turters" can be viewed here.
Shellbrow Wagon is a shop in . It is run by Isalle and can be found in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. It is specialized in Desserts.

Serpentine Lizards (Japanese: , Akamadara Rizado) are enemies in . They are Lizards and can be found at level 4 - 10 on the Lower Level or Upper Level - Right of the Gormott Province, particularly around Lyta Oasis or Wrecc Marshland. These enemies drop no items.
Shield Tirkin (Japanese: , Shīrudo Tākin) are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family and can be found at level 12-17 on Melnath's Shoulder or at Twin Trunks Hill in the Gormott Province.

Shadow Scouts (Japanese: , Shadou Sukauto) are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family and can be found at level 14-16 on Melnath's Shoulder or at Twin Trunks Hill in the Gormott Province. When they detect the party, they will first travel to the closest group of Tirkin, the members of which will then target the party as well.
Shralk Ignas (Japanese: , Shuraku Igūna) are enemies in . They are Ignas and can be found at level 72-74 in Badfella's Cave Fort in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya.
Shreddle Vangs (Japanese: , Shureddo Vanpu) are enemies in . They are members of the Vang family, and can be found at level 44-46 at the Bone Road on the Upper Level of the Spirit Crucible Elpys.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Shell Shoes (Japanese: , Sheru Shūzu) are accessories in and . They increase the wearer's Agility stat by up to 22%. The Assassin Shoes, Ester Shoes and Dauntless Boots accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect. For a similar additive effect that can stack with this gear, check the Wolf Shoes and Spring Shoes accessories.
Shadow Slice (Japanese: , Shadousuraisā, Lit. "Shadow Slicer") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Greataxe.

Shade Trouts are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in the Spirit Crucible Elpys, in particular at Underground River Lavi, Subterranean Lake Galantia, or by Salvaging at the Canyon of Husks or the Portal of the Hero. Seven of them are needed during the quest Difficult Decisions.
Shark Geckos are Insect collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya. In the , Shark Geckos can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.
Shell Rocks are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal, specifically from the Collection Point at the entrance to the Sacred Ice Caverns.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Shell Cameos (Japanese: , Sheru Kameo) are accessories in and . They increase the amount of HP recovered by the wearer when healed by up to 14%. They affect the healing effects provided by Recovery-type and Defensive-type Arts, revivals and the special healing granted by some other other accessories and Blade Skills, but will not impact HP recovered from HP Potions. The DLC exclusive Marble Cameo accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect. For accessories that affect the healing effect of HP Potions, check the Activity Amulet, Healing Amulet and Rebirth Amulet.

Sheba's Dream is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Central Exchange in the Argentum Trade Guild. Choosing the top option raises Pyra's Trust by 100 and Sheba's Trust by 900, while the bottom option raises Brighid's Trust by 100 and Sheba's Trust by 900. It must be viewed to unlock Sheba's Lv 2 Lockpicking. If the party stays at Lemour Inn before viewing, Sheba will direct her Driver to its location.
Shredder Spiral (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using Twin Rings.
Shogun Slash (Japanese: , Shōgun surasshu) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Chroma Katana.
Shell Shot (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Bitball. In the , it is also one of Zeke's arts when using Bunnie.

Selmo Gradies (Japanese: , Serumo Guradi) are enemies in . They are members of the Grady family and can be found at level 31 - 33 on Baldotas Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago during auroras. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Perun's level 2 "Ice Mastery" field skill.

Shaft Chips are Core Chips in and . They can only be dropped by Organl Griffoxes, Tempest Pterix, and Demon King Gilbert in as well as rewarded for Challenge Battle Mode challenges with the DLC. In they can only be dropped by Herculean Gibson. Shaft Chips share their appearance with Chain Chips, Magnet Chips, and Coil Chips. __TOC__

Shipbuilding Wood is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province during the quest Umon Bounces Back. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Wind Mastery" and "Leaping" Field Skills. Completing this mission unlocks the Merc Mission Craftsman's Skills.

Segel Ansels (Japanese: , Seigeru Anseru) are enemies in . They are members of the Ansel family, and can be found at level 34-45 at the Ansel Hatchery in the Leftherian Archipelago. Two must be defeated to unlock Corvin's level 3 Ex Tenebris Lux Blade Special.
Shimmun Tirkin (Japanese: , Shimonnu Tākin) are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 30-35 on Daram Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Shatoto is an NPC in . Shatoto is a rough-sleeping Nopon who can be found in Galad Residential Zone in the Gormott Province, about halfway down the tower in a small alcove, accessible by dropping down from the top. Shatoto gives the quest No-Penny Nopon, and must be given Ruska Noodle Soup to cheer him up, as he was sent into town to buy food for his mother but tricked out of his money by a group of Ardainian soldiers.
Sholto is an NPC in . He is a Leftherian courier who can be found at Rigitte Harbor in the Leftherian Archipelago during Time is Money.
Shaun is an NPC in . Shaun is an Urayan who can be found in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Sheba's Tea Party 1 is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain. The series of the five related missions Sheba's Tea Party 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 are unlocked upon completion of the Blade Quest Fool's Gold. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Focus", "Fire Mastery" and "Wind Mastery" Field Skills.

Sheba's Tea Party 2 is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain. The series of the five related missions Sheba's Tea Party 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 are unlocked upon completion of the Blade Quest Fool's Gold. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Ancient Wisdom", "Water Mastery" and "Electric Mastery" Field Skills.

Sheba's Tea Party 3 is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain. The series of the five related missions Sheba's Tea Party 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 are unlocked upon completion of the Blade Quest Fool's Gold. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Fortitude", "Earth Mastery" and "Dark Mastery" Field Skills.

Sheba's Tea Party 4 is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain. The series of the five related missions Sheba's Tea Party 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 are unlocked upon completion of the Blade Quest Fool's Gold. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Keen Eye", "Ice Mastery" and "Electric Mastery" Field Skills.

The Ship-Eating Taos (Japanese: , Senkangui no Taōsu) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Taos family, and must be fought at level 42 twice, near the Port and Starboard Decks of the Titan Battleship in the Gormott Province during Newt Recruits.

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Shackle Blade Resist (Japanese: , Bureido Fūsa Teikō) is an Aux Core or a DLC Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It boosts the user's resistance to the Shackle Blade debuff by up to 100%, allowing for full immunity to the status. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent, after installing the Patch (Ver.1.5.1). __TOC__

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Shoulder to Shoulder (Japanese: , Kōkō Kizuna) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM / Upgrade in and . It increases the Affinity of the entire party by up to 250 at the start of the battle, when the enemy starts with initiative. The enemy gains initiative when they detect the player before they have a chance to unsheathe their weapons. This effect will uniquely apply even when the equipped Blade is not engaged on the field, and stacks with all "Shoulder to Shoulders" equipped to Blades on the active party. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. For another equipment with a similar effect

The Senior Officer's Key is a Key Item in . It is found in the Hangar of the Titan Battleship in the Gormott Province. It grants access to the bridge control switch in the Hangar Passage. This item cannot be obtained until after completing Chapter 2.
The Shimmering Feather is a Key Item in . It is obtained in the Ansel Hatchery in the Leftherian Archipelago during Hero of the Nopon.
Serge is an NPC in . He is a young Urayan who can be found at Seoris Plaza in the Indoline Praetorium during Mellica the Chorister.

The Serenade is a Key Item in . It can be prepared from a recipe requiring four Cranberry Bells and six Panda Pansies at Rumbletum Canteen in the Argentum Trade Guild during the quest Fame and Family.
The Sharp Tablet Piece is a Key Item in . It is obtained at the Old Gelgemos Gate on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal during the quest Lost Kingdom.
The Shining Stalactite is a Key Item in . It is located near Cenotaph Bridge on the Mid Level of the Spirit Crucible Elpys during the quest Difficult Decisions.

Shuddering Tonfa (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Sword Tonfa. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Zeke's Dynamite Knuckle.

The Sentynel Drivers (Japanese: , Senchineru Doraibā) are five quest-exclusive enemies in . They are Driver enemies fought at level 62 at the Titan Weapon Dig Site in Temperantia during The Lone Watchman.
Seesee is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found in the Residential Area of Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal during the day. He offers the Merc Mission Confidential Documents.
Seekhelos is an NPC in . Seekhelos is a Tantalese who can be found at the Capital Approach in the Kingdom of Tantal. He offers the Merc Mission Ether Furnace Checks.
Severtine is an NPC in . He is an Indoline who can be found in the Indoline Praetorium. He runs Icarus Butchers.

Shrine of Offering 1 is an Info Item in . It and Shrine of Offering 2 must be interpreted from the Nopon Mural at the Shrine of Offering during the quest The Nopon Murals. * Water Mastery Lv2 and Fortitude Lv1 Field Skills are required to access, and Nopon Wisdom Lv3 and Keen Eye Lv1 to obtain the information.

Shrine of Offering 2 is an Info Item in . It and Shrine of Offering 1 must be interpreted from the Nopon Mural at the Shrine of Offering during the quest The Nopon Murals. * Water Mastery Lv2 and Fortitude Lv1 Field Skills are required to access, and Nopon Wisdom Lv3 and Keen Eye Lv1 to obtain the information.

Shrine of Light 1 is an Info Item in . It and the Shrine of Light 2 must be found by investigating the Nopon Mural at the Shrine of Light during The Nopon Murals. * Wind Mastery Lv2 and Leaping Lv1 are required to access, and then Nopon Wisdom Lv3 and Keen Eye Lv1 to gain the information.

The Shrine of Light 2 is an Info Item in . It and the Shrine of Light 1 must be found by investigating the Nopon Mural at the Shrine of Light during The Nopon Murals. * Wind Mastery Lv2 and Leaping Lv1 are required to access, and then Nopon Wisdom Lv3 and Keen Eye Lv1 to gain the information.

Shrine of Journeys 1 is an Info Item in . It and Shrine of Journeys 2 can be obtained by investigating the Nopon Mural at the Shrine of Journeys in Garfont Village during The Nopon Murals. * Water Mastery Lv2 and Fortitude Lv1 are required to access the shrine, and then Nopon Wisdom Lv3 and Keen Eye Lv1 to gain the information.

Shrine of Journeys 2 is an Info Item in .
